snippet.title: PlayStation - Power Rangers Zeo - Full Tilt Battle Pinball (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
5 stunning 3-D modeled playfields, breathtaking SGI rendered cinemas and groundbreaking texture-based graphics are just a few of the reasons you'll flip for Power Rangers Zeo Full Tilt Battle Pinball. Add real arcade-like pinball playability and throw in your favorite Zeo Rangers, the Gold Ranger, the Zeo Zords, King Mondo, Queen Machina, Alpha S, and more, and you've got the most exciting pinball experience in video game history!
